items.q: So we used to rehearse a lot at this Bill Mather's place. He had a drum shop there. So we would all hang out there in Bill's shop

ctx.x: You know. So we used to rehearse a lot at this Bill Mather's place. He had a drum shop there. So we would all hang out there in Bill's shop, you know. And Adrian and I became real tight, because he'd show me things. "Wait a minute, kid, let me show you how that goes." "Let me show you the fingering." You know? Because I used to have trouble getting real fast going up the vibes.
